about.title: About
about.intro: Dr. Elif Demir Uğur (EDU) is a scholar, Master Certified Coach (MCC), people & culture leader, and mythological novelist.
about.titles: Ph.D., MBA, MSc · MCC, ORSCC, NLP
about.bio: Over twenty-six years she has braided education, human resources, coaching, and mentoring. Co-founder of Thorius Eğitim ve Danışmanlık; founded and led Coaching & Mentoring at FLO Group; mentors STEM-graduate young women with UNDP; leads projects at ICF Turkey and founded the ICF Running Team. She is a senior executive who completed CHRO training at BMI Business School. Years as a mathematics teacher (MEF International, Avrupa Koleji, Kültür Koleji, MoNE) shaped her academic and pedagogical foundation.
about.langs: Turkish (native) · English (professional) · French, German, Italian, Spanish
about.volunteer: As founder and project leader of the ICF Running Team, she organized charity runs for children’s education; provided volunteer coaching for TEGV and ÖRAV teachers; and supported TEMA nature projects.

coaching.title: Coaching
coaching.description: Executive coaching and student coaching with Dr. Elif Demir Uğur — ICF MCC, authentic leadership, and pedagogical depth.
coaching.intro: I bring more than twenty-six years across education, human resources, and coaching together with ICF Master Certified Coach (MCC) and ORSCC credentials. My work is to help leaders and students clarify their own voice, find direction, and take steps that last.
coaching.executiveBody: One-to-one coaching for senior leaders, people & culture executives, and decision-makers. As a practitioner who founded and led Coaching & Mentoring at FLO Group, I open space beyond title — so a leader can hear their own voice and build a more honest bond with their teams.
executiveOutcomes: Authentic leadership and clarity in decision-making
People & culture architecture, team climate, and communication
Leadership transitions, expanded roles, and sustainable performance
Building a coaching culture and mentoring systems
coaching.studentBody: Years as a mathematics teacher and mentoring STEM-graduate young women with UNDP shape how I work with students. With high school and university students and early-career candidates, we focus on learning discipline, self-trust, direction, and the balance between academic and personal life. The aim is not simply higher grades — it is for the student to recognize their potential and own their path.
studentOutcomes: Learning discipline, focus, and study rhythm
Self-trust, motivation, and exam or performance anxiety
Direction-setting, university choices, and early-career steps
Mentoring support on STEM and academic journeys

books.title: Books
books.seriesIntro: A novel series woven from mythology, love, and ancient language.
books.auroraTitle: Aurora — A Mythology of Skyborne Love
books.auroraSubtitle: Fire and Air · The Mythology of Liberating Love
books.auroraBlurb: The sky caught fire once. Every star you see is the memory of an ember that burned. On one side, Odâra — flame returning from ash; on the other, Yelvân — the horizon that sets free. When the two met, the light people later called Aurora lit the heavens for the first time. But every light is followed by a shadow: the devouring pit Obrân, stolen embers, a will put to the test… A world where love grows not by possession, but by opening a horizon before the one you love. Speaking its own mythology and its own tongue, this novel asks what loving truly means: the beloved is not a destination, but a horizon that carries you to the light within — and from there, to the sky. Carrying the finesse of ancient wisdom into a modern narrative, Aurora is the first link in the seven-book Ancient Language Myths series. For those who listen to the sky.
books.auroraQuote: If you are the one who makes the light, no one can put it out.
books.auroraAccess: A journey that begins with a language forgotten and continues with an awakening — now reachable from anywhere in the world.
